import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))

# 1. Sales by Product
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
product_sales = data.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
product_sales.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color='steelblue')
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Product')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Sales by Hour
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
data['hour'] = pd.to_datetime(data['time'], format='%H:%M').dt.hour
hourly_sales = data.groupby('hour')['total'].sum()
ax2.plot(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, color='darkgreen')
ax2.set_title('Sales by Hour of Day', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Hour')
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. Payment Method Distribution
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
payment_counts = data['payment_method'].value_counts()
colors = ['#ff9999', '#66b3ff']
ax3.pie(payment_counts.values, labels=payment_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Sales by Customer Age Group
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
age_sales = data.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
age_sales.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax4, color='coral')
ax4.set_title('Total Sales by Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax4.set_ylabel('Age Group')

# 5. Takeaway vs Dine-in
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
takeaway_sales = data.groupby('is_takeaway')['total'].sum()
labels = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
colors = ['#99ff99', '#ffcc99']
ax5.bar(labels, takeaway_sales.values, color=colors, edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.5)
ax5.set_title('Takeaway vs Dine-in Sales', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')

# 6. Product Size Distribution
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
size_counts = data['size'].value_counts()
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
size_counts = size_counts.reindex(size_order, fill_value=0)
ax6.bar(size_counts.index, size_counts.values, color='mediumpurple', edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.5)
ax6.set_title('Product Size Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Size')
ax6.set_ylabel('Count')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
